notes: I replaced the two-Gaussian central model (which badly missed the true asymmetric shape) with a piecewise-linear interpolation through the E24/E14 grid points, and fixed the positive-side mid-range so it hits the observed zero crossing near x=22.4 and the correct slopes through 22–65 (the old code had a spurious kink at 21.5 and wrong values at 4.5).
